basics.name: Chirag Batra
basics.title: B.Tech CS (Data Science) · Class of 2027
basics.summary: Final-year Computer Science (Data Science) student, class of 2027, targeting ML engineering and data science roles. I build ML systems end to end and measure them honestly: real-time fraud detection on AWS, causal uplift modeling and a multi-agent LLM deployment platform. Two data internships, including IBM.

highlights: Built EventLens AI, a full-stack financial risk analytics platform in Python, computing Value-at-Risk and Monte Carlo projections for portfolio exposure.
Trained a Random Forest model using a Scikit-learn pipeline on 250+ event-days of GDELT news data to predict abnormal returns from news sentiment and volatility features.
Developed ETL pipelines aggregating news event data with live market pricing into a SQLAlchemy database, delivered through FastAPI REST services and a React reporting dashboard.
Developed Python preprocessing pipelines to clean drift and noise from four sensor telemetry streams, including GPS, IMU, barometric pressure, and temperature data.
Implemented automated quality control checks that detected altitude-control anomalies in time-series sensor data.
Conducted comparative analysis across five operational scenarios, quantifying performance trade-offs for technical stakeholders.

certifications: Data Analytics Virtual Experience Program, Deloitte Australia (Forage)
Data Structures and Algorithms using Python, Tutedude

projects.name: RADAR: Real-time Agentic Detection and Reporting
projects.description: Streaming fraud detection on AWS: XGBoost scoring at 0.4 ms median (717 req/s in load tests) with 89.6% recall at 1% FPR on 606k synthetic transactions, beating rules (66.8%) and logistic regression (73.7%). Hourly PSI drift monitoring triggers champion/challenger retraining; a Bedrock tool-use agent investigates flagged transactions and returns schema-validated verdicts. ~60 AWS resources in Terraform, CI with OIDC deploys, 42 tests.

projects.name: Customer Churn Prediction and Retention Uplift Modeling
projects.description: Churn model on a 7,032-customer telecom dataset reaching 0.82 AUC-ROC with XGBoost. Uplift modeling identified persuadable customers, cutting simulated retention campaign spend by 56% while maintaining retention rates. Streamlit and FastAPI dashboard with SHAP explainability; experiments tracked in MLflow.

projects.name: DeploySmith OS
projects.description: A portfolio that doubles as a multi-agent deployment platform: LangGraph agents statically profile a GitHub repo, plan its hosting, build it in hardened Docker containers and health-check the result, streaming every step over SSE. Immutable deploys with build logs and one-click rollback; 200+ pytest tests.

projects.name: Proactive Academic Intervention System
projects.description: End-to-end ML web app analyzing 5,000+ records to predict at-risk individuals, reaching 0.887 ROC-AUC with class-balanced Logistic Regression. Automated feature engineering from MySQL, a max-heap priority queue for ranking, and sliding-window anomaly detection. Flask backend deployed on Render.
